corrected_text: LiteRT-LM's GetModelInfo copies supports_thinking and supports_function_calling from the LlmMetadata proto (fields 11 and 12); Google's E2B (b3ca0d2f) and E4B files don't set them, so ModelInfo reports both false for these models, as Agello's InferencePlanner comment (a691212) notes for E2B (it ignores both flags).
note: Re-verified at Agello HEAD a691212 (read only). InferencePlanner.swift:289-291 comment: caps.thinking, like caps.functionCalling, is not trusted (the E2B file reports false for both); applyCapabilities uses neither. model_info.cc and the generated table unchanged.
